courses.title: Foundations of Computing
courses.description: Survey of core ideas in computing: data representation, algorithms, abstraction, and software engineering practice. Prepares students for upper-division CSS coursework with collaborative projects and introductory programming exercises.

courses.title: Data Structures and Algorithms
courses.description: Design and analysis of fundamental data structures including lists, trees, heaps, hash tables, and graphs. Algorithmic techniques such as sorting, searching, recursion, and graph traversal. Emphasis on complexity analysis and implementation trade-offs.

courses.title: Software Engineering
courses.description: Principles of software development life cycle, requirements engineering, design modeling, testing strategies, version control, and team collaboration. Students apply agile methods to build a multi-component software system.

courses.title: Operating Systems
courses.description: Processes and threads, CPU scheduling, synchronization and deadlocks, memory management, virtual memory, file systems, and I/O subsystems. Hands-on labs reinforce concepts using a contemporary operating system.

courses.title: Business Communication
courses.description: Professional writing and presentation skills for business contexts. Covers audience analysis, persuasive messaging, data visualization in reports, and collaborative communication norms expected in internships and early-career roles.

courses.title: Matrix Algebra with Applications
courses.description: Linear systems, matrices, determinants, vector spaces, eigenvalues and eigenvectors, and orthogonalization. Applications include computer graphics transformations, Markov chains, and introductory machine learning geometry.
